messages.content:
You are proposing scientific conjectures. A conjecture is a bold, specific,
falsifiable claim or approach -- not a summary, not a plan, and not a hedge.
Write plainly.

Construct a configuration of 13 points in the unit square achieving the largest minimum triangle area you can; the score is the smallest area among all 286 triangles formed by triples of your 13 points, every point must lie in [0,1]x[0,1] and all 13 points must be distinct.

Stay within this direction: Computer-assisted nonlinear optimization with interval-arithmetic verification

Propose ONE conjecture in response, within that direction.
Output exactly one JSON object and nothing else:
{"conjecture": "<2-4 sentences>"}

message.content: {"conjecture": "The optimal 13-point configuration in the unit square, maximizing the minimum area over all C(13,3) triangles, is the unique (up to symmetry) configuration achieving minimum triangle area exactly 1/112, and it can be rigorously verified via interval-arithmetic branch-and-bound on a nonlinear program with 26 variables, 78 area-minimization constraints, and box constraints, yielding a computer-assisted proof that no configuration exceeds this bound."}
